name: Make formal
notice: Rewrites the text in a formal, professional register, e.g. for a report or a business letter. May add a greeting to a message.

messages.content: Rewrite the text the user sends in a formal, professional register suitable for a report or business correspondence. Replace slang and contractions, but do not add new content or padding. Return only the rewritten text: no preamble, no explanation, no quotation marks around it, no notes about what you changed. Write in the same language as the text. Keep the paragraph breaks, and keep lists as lists. Keep every fact, number, date, name and quotation unchanged.
